acceptance_criteria.description: Users must not be able to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials. Unauthenticated access should be blocked.
kane_steps: Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe whether the page is accessible or the user is redirected
Verify the user is NOT shown the inventory page and is redirected to the login page
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Unauthenticated users cannot access protected pages

acceptance_criteria.description: After submitting valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce), the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the Login button
Verify the user is redirected to the inventory page (URL contains /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page must display product tiles, each containing the product name, an image, and a price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the inventory page
Inspect the displayed product tiles
Verify each tile shows a product name, a product image, and a price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on the name of any product
Verify the product detail page is opened for the selected product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on the image of any product
Verify the product detail page is opened for the selected product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page must display the product name, description, price, and an 'Add to cart' button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product to open its detail page
Verify the page shows the product name, a description, a price, and an 'Add to cart' button
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product detail page shows all required fields

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the 'Add to cart' button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Navigate to the cart page
Verify the selected product appears in the cart
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product can be added to cart from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking 'Add to cart' on a product tile, the button label changes to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate a product tile with an 'Add to cart' button
Click the 'Add to cart' button
Verify the button label on that product tile now reads 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button changes to Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: After adding a product to the cart, the cart badge in the top navigation updates to reflect the current number of items in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the cart badge count (or its absence)
Click 'Add to cart' on one product
Verify the cart badge in the top navigation displays '1'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge updates with item count

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a product from the cart directly from the inventory page by clicking the 'Remove' button on a previously added product.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Locate the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Click the 'Remove' button
Navigate to the cart page and verify the product is no longer listed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product can be removed from cart via inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking 'Remove' on a product tile, the button label changes back to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Click the 'Remove' button on that product tile
Verify the button label reverts to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button reverts to Add to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the cart icon in the top navigation
Verify the URL changes to contain /cart.html and the cart page is displayed

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all items that have been added to the cart, each showing the item name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in, add at least two products to the cart from the inventory page
Navigate to the cart page at /cart.html
Verify each added item is listed with its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page lists items with name, quantity, price

acceptance_criteria.description: A sort dropdown is visible in the top-right area of the inventory page, allowing users to select a sort option.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top-right area
Verify the dropdown is visible and clickable
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown is present on inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The sort dropdown contains exactly four options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the sort dropdown
Verify the available options are 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low)'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown has four correct options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' sorts the product list so the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Onesie' priced at $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high shows cheapest product first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' sorts the product list alphabetically so that 'Sauce Labs Backpack' appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Select 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z shows Backpack first
